_comment: U-Net road segmentation. Uses the bundled road_unet.pth checkpoint at the repo root (resnet34 encoder, trained on OSM-derived labels at ~0.054 m/px Astana tiles). Sliding-window inference at 512px patches, vectorised to road polygons. Run with: uv run terrascope2 --config packages/cli2/examples/job.unet_roads.json

kwargs._comment_device: Auto-selects mps/cuda/cpu when omitted. Force a specific backend here.
kwargs._comment_threshold: Sigmoid cutoff. Lower → more roads, more false positives.
kwargs._comment_min_area: Drops speckle blobs smaller than this many pixels.
